verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents end-user/admin management tools (desktop/mobile companion apps, fido2-manage CLI/GUI, PIV minidriver, Entra ID bulk-enroll scripts) — these let users and admins manage keys, but none of them constitute an official SDK/library that developers can embed into their own desktop or mobile apps to integrate key functionality. FIDO2/WebAuthn is referenced only via standard browser APIs, not a Token2-provided SDK.
